name: Kraken’s Hunger

features.name: Squid retriggers
features.description: Every four squid wilds add 10 spins, up to three times.

review:
A deep-sea treasure hunt on a grid that changes size: 5x3, 5x4 or 5x5, with 5, 10 or 20 lines to match.

Three, four or five compass scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, and in the bonus, collecting four squid wilds adds 10 more – up to three times a round, so it can run for a long time. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.2% RTP – one of the best here. Free spins about once every 258 spins. Calm and surprisingly good value.
pros: Excellent 97.20% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
